title: November 7 update
summary: A bug-fix update: the Gunship Killstreak, Map Voting for three-map playlists, Battle Pass token progress and a batch of DMZ X01 fixes.
modes: Map Voting now supports three map and mode combos, like Shransit.
Fixed Grind objectives not spawning in Private Match.
DMZ: player kills in X01 no longer raise Bounty Level more than intended.
other: Fixed players being kicked out of the Gunship Killstreak when their Operator was eliminated.
Fixed Field Upgrade equipment being lost on some surfaces on Lithium.
Fixed Battle Pass progress not rolling over when a Token was used.
Fixed players getting stuck on the scoreboard after a Hardcore match.
Operator Selection menu now shows Operator Variants more clearly.
DMZ: fixes for X01 stability, The Captain and Colossus killing players in Last Stand, SAM Sites hitting paid Light Helo Infils, the Orders menu and the BlackCell camo challenge.

title: November 6 update
summary: Shransit playlist and Hardcore in Quickplay, a better Damage Recap, and DMZ stealth gear now hides you from upgraded UAV Towers.
modes: New Shransit playlist: Shipment, Shoot House and Transit 213.
Hardcore is now in Quickplay.
DMZ: Thermal Padding, Thermal Padding Pro and Sedative Inhaler now hide you from UAVs and upgraded UAV Towers. AUAV fire support still finds you.
other: Damage Recap now shows Quick Fix healing, damage through surfaces, Bomb Squad reduction and Spawn Protection.
Fixed Loadouts breaking after Prestiging and a freeze on first loadout edit in a match.
Fixed completed Events not counting toward Event Mastery Camo progress.
Fixed the Kastov 762 Apex alternate fire stopping after a Munitions Box or Ammo Cache in Ground War.
DMZ: fixes for BlackCell rewards and challenges, Order and Calling Card tracking, and Rocket Launcher Blueprints in the Gunsmith.

title: Season 1 update
summary: Season 1 goes live at 9 PM PT. 17 guns retuned (Hyeon Hyperburst Apex and APOC-338 nerfed), Hardcore health cut, Claymores and mines arm faster, and the Cronen Osprey and CSG-35 arrive.

changes.text: Medium damage range up 11% and muzzle velocity up 13%.
Headshot multiplier raised from 1.25 to 1.3.
Medium damage 24 to 25. The Hyperburst Apex takes a big hit: max damage 30 to 23, min damage 25 to 20, and its mid damage band is gone, but max range is up 26%.
Medium damage 24 to 25 with longer range, and higher head, neck and upper torso multipliers.
Max range up 8% and headshot multiplier 1.25 to 1.3. Hurricane Apex max range up 11%.
Max damage range up 7% and ADS move speed up.
Max damage range up 11% and min damage 13 to 14.
Medium 2 damage 13 to 14 and min damage 12 to 13.
Damage ranges shortened about 4 to 5%, min damage 13 to 14.
Max damage 26 to 27, min damage 17 to 19, headshot 1.3 to 1.4. The second mid damage band is removed.
Medium 2 damage 15 to 16 and min damage 13 to 14.
Min damage 33 to 32 and headshot multiplier 1.35 to 1.3.
Max damage range up 3% and headshot 1.25 to 1.3. Assault Apex gets more range and 23 medium damage.
Damage ranges up, min damage 14 to 16. Enforcer Apex ranges up and min damage 19 to 20.
Max damage range up 9%.
Max damage range up 19% and min damage 58 to 63.
Max damage range up 6% and lower torso multiplier 1.0 to 1.1.

modes: New maps: Backstab and Canyon, plus Shoot House returns and Kill Block: Crash joins the featured combos.
Grind returns and Drop Zone joins the rotation. Gauntlet 1v1 is coming soon through a Wager Match event.
New weapons: Cronen Osprey (AR) and CSG-35 (SMG) come with the Battle Pass. Two more guns and new attachments arrive later in the season.
Hardcore max health cut from 30 to 22.
Argonaut killstreak health 800 to 1,200. Crossfire gets spawn protection but less bullet damage and radius.
Claymore arms in 0.75 s (was 1 s) with a wider trigger cone and range. Proximity Mine arms in 0.75 s (was 1.5 s).
DMZ: new X01 underground black site reached from Hajin, a 3D Printer and new vendor at the FOB, and Supplied Drops now works on Dynamic Op crates.
DMZ: Possum lockout radius is 2.5x bigger and its failsafe timer goes from 4 to 5 minutes.
other: Fixes for Birdseye, Battle Hardened, Portable Radar in Free For All, Smoke Wall, Wheelson, Deathstalker and killfeed icons.
Fixed a Proximity Mine exploit on Seeker Drones and an out-of-bounds exploit at Wolves Stadium.
Hijack, Search and Destroy and Gunfight fixes.
DMZ: Weapon XP from vehicle kills against AI lowered, Banks battery spawns reduced, and many fixes for exfil, vehicles and Dynamic Ops.

title: October 30 update
summary: Infected joins the Halloween weekend playlist, plus server fixes and bigger DMZ cash rewards.
modes: Infected added to the playlist for Halloween weekend.
DMZ: Dynamic Ops now pay 10,000 to 20,000 cash, Side Ops pay 2,000 and mission steps pay 500 each.
other: Fixed server crashes.
Fixed a black screen after auto-assign team switches in Private Matches.
Fixed early AFK kicks in Search and Destroy.
Fixed exploits on Coal.
DMZ: fixes for Broken Resupply and Hunt Operator ops, Boss Board Intel purchases, the helmet-hit icon color, FOB shadows and a FOB crash.

title: October 29 update
summary: Possession arrives for Halloween, XP is up in several modes, and DMZ cash rewards go up again.
modes: Possession added as a Halloween playlist mode.
XP rates raised across several Multiplayer modes.
DMZ: cash rewards raised for Dynamic Ops, Side Ops and Story Mission replays.
other: Fixed Lithium visuals and out-of-bounds spots on Silkworm and Mumbai.
Fixed the Domination scoreboard timer and removed extra callouts on Shipment.
Fixed Mastery Camo progress counting squadmate actions.
DMZ: fixes for Scavenger detection on deploy, hostage pickup, Dog Tag extraction, Hajin stuck spots and a helicopter collision on exfil.
Fixed Calling Card requirements and a white flash in menus.
The Level 37 3-Plate Armor Vest fix only applied to players who hadn't reached that level yet. A fix for affected players is in progress.

title: October 28 update
summary: First weapon tuning pass: hit-location damage is more consistent and SMGs get stronger. Shipment 24/7, Kill Block Gunfight and Gun Game arrive.

changes.text: Max range raised, but neck and upper torso multipliers lowered.
Max range raised.
Max range raised.
Neck, upper torso and lower torso multipliers lowered. Sentinel Apex range and muzzle velocity reduced.
Hyperburst Apex: full-auto damage lowered, full-auto range raised, and mid damage range 1 removed.
Light barrel and skeleton grip have a smaller recoil control penalty.
ISO Nightshade, PPSh-41, VEL 46, Wz.55 Striga and X-58 Nyx have higher limb multipliers.
ADS-in and movement speeds adjusted.
Void Apex range raised.
Head multiplier raised and Void Apex range raised.
Damage and range lowered.
Range and upper arm multipliers lowered.
Assault Apex minimum damage raised.
12G Slug mid damage range 2 lowered.
Health regen now stops when you take damage. Hitmarker icon updated.
Closed an out-of-bounds exploit.

modes: Shipment 24/7, Kill Block 6v6 Gunfight and Gun Game added.
Free For All has a score limit of 30 and a party limit of 2.
other: Dive velocity cut by 23% to stop a sprint-jump exploit. A longer-term fix is planned.
DMZ: the Possum trait can't activate while the killing team is nearby or until 4 minutes pass.
Fixes for camo and Calling Card UI, Prestige resets, killfeed icons, Gun Game character select, challenge range tracking, UAV visibility on Sentry and Mosin-Nagant visuals.
Known issues: Patriot XMR Platinum camo tracking, Calling Card tracking, Best Play, and Classic Prestige class creation via DMZ.

title: October 25 update
summary: More XP in Search and Destroy and Collateral, plus Multiplayer and DMZ fixes.
modes: Search and Destroy and Collateral: XP per kill raised from 100 to 300.
other: Rolled back a Search and Destroy bomb stretching fix.
Fixed Collateral bomb behavior and a freeze on first loadout edits.
Fixed Frontline and Hijack announcer intros.
Fixed Patriot XMR, Oden and Cronen Squall weapon class labels.
Fixed a Korean-language launch issue and Gunsmith and Prestige UI bugs.
DMZ: Drill Charge damage to the Colossus reduced, Hospital Elevator bypass closed, and you must clear your Overflow Stash before deploying.

title: October 24 update
summary: Hijack spawn timing improved, plus visual and exploit fixes in Multiplayer and DMZ.

changes.text: Fixed an attachment visual bug.

modes: Hijack spawn and respawn timing improved.
other: Fixed La Sombra Venenosa magazine bullet visuals.
Fixed Portable Radar in Hardcore and a Search and Destroy defuse exploit.
Fixed a Deathstalker out-of-bounds spot on Rooftops and Collateral favorite Operators.
DMZ: fixes for Hajin rocks, party leaders removing teammates, the exfil helicopter disappearing, Shopping Mission reinforcements and Philanthropist Order tracking.

title: October 23 update
summary: Apex Attachments are pulled for now while weapon tuning is reviewed. FFA allows parties of 4.

changes.text: Removed for now. They will return soon.
Tuning for DMZ and Multiplayer is under review.
Weapon level icons added.
Now has 3 uses.
No longer breaks right away in radiation zones.

modes: Parties of up to 4 can queue for Free For All.
DMZ: you can steal back UAV Towers.
other: Events panel updated.
Fixed Portable Radar in FFA and Deathstalker collisions on Summit.
DMZ: fixes for stability, Bounties, Hajin rocks, Lieutenant Hunt progress, AI helicopters, missing audio and killstreak drops.

title: Launch patch
summary: Infinity Ward's pre-launch update. Every gun got a balance pass, SMGs got stronger up close, and one-shot weapons got toned down.

changes.text: More effective at close to mid range.
Tempered with flinch and damage tuning.
Full balance pass, and attachments were retuned.
Prestiging a gun relocks its attachments, shared ones included.
Now negates most of the effects of Flash, Concussion and Screamer Mine.
First recharge comes in faster.
Tactical Sprint now comes from this perk, triggered by your sprint key by default.
Effective range and duration slightly reduced.
Effective range and duration slightly reduced.
Health up from 100 to 150. Still costs 5 kills, or 4 with Hardline.
Pathing and targeting reworked to be more aggressive.

modes: 20 maps at launch: 12 Core 6v6, 4 Gunfight and 3 Ground War, plus Kill Block for 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight.
New modes: Inflation, Hijack, Collateral, Combat Outpost and Hardcore.
Infected and Possession arrive the week after launch.
Proving Grounds adds a movement and combat training course.
Smart Streaks: objective play now fills your killstreak meter.
Spawn tuning for player separation, squad spawns and Hardpoint.
other: Fixed a server crash during Multiplayer matches.
Fixed visual issues on Cachette.
Fixed Seeker Drone deploying out of bounds.
Fixed the killstreak counter resetting after Argonaut.
Fixed match completions not being recorded.
Fixed the Firing Range showing 0.00 TTK for the Rezi 12.
Gunsmith builds now save manually. Edits made in a match still save on their own.
Shorter pre-game countdowns and earlier map preloading.
